name: Carrion Defense Works Field Surgical Kit FSK-6
product_name: Carrion Defense Works Field Surgical Kit FSK-6
description: A comprehensive surgical kit designed for emergency field operations — containing scalpels, hemostats, retractors, suture materials, a compact cauterizer, bone saw, and a diagnostic scanner for guiding procedures without imaging equipment. The FSK-6 is designed for trained field medics performing procedures that cannot wait for evacuation to a medical facility — bullet extraction, internal hemorrhage repair, emergency amputation, and cyberware emergency disconnection. The kit includes Lazarus RWCNS nanite injectors for wound closure and a neural interface link that provides AR-guided surgical assistance overlaid on the operative field.
story_hooks: An FSK-6 was used to perform field surgery on a shooting victim in a Tier 1 hallway — the AR-guided procedure was performed by someone with no formal medical training who followed the overlay instructions perfectly.
A modified FSK-6 has been configured specifically for forced cyberware removal — the AR guide walks an operator through disconnecting and extracting neural interface hardware from a living subject.
